i1.title: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 125ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Sparkling, juicy and full of sunshine.

Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 125ml is a youthful fruity floral fragrance for women, created by perfumer Alberto Morillas and launched in 2011. Grapefruit, raspberry and pear open fresh and sparkling, a heart of violet, rose, jasmine and lychee adds a soft floral glow, and it settles onto a light base of musk, cedar and plum.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Grapefruit, Raspberry, Pear, Green Notes
  • Heart: Violet, Rose, Jasmine, Lychee, Apple Blossom
  • Base: Musk, Cedar, Plum

Key details

  • Brand: Marc Jacobs
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 125ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Fruity
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A sparkling grapefruit, raspberry and pear opening
  • A soft violet, rose and jasmine heart
  • A light musk, cedar and plum finish
  • Generous 125ml Eau de Toilette

FAQ

What does Daisy Eau So Fresh smell like?

Grapefruit, raspberry, pear and green notes first, then violet, rose, jasmine, lychee and apple blossom, finishing with musk, cedar and plum.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
